﻿WITH raw_tracking AS (
    SELECT
        game_id,
        player_id,
        player_name,
        game_date,
        season,
        distance_miles,
        avg_speed_mph,
        fast_break_points,
        touches
    FROM "nba_injuries"."bronze"."raw_player_tracking"
)

SELECT
    game_id,
    player_id,
    player_name,
    game_date,
    season,
    distance_miles,
    avg_speed_mph,
    
    -- Estimativa de Carga Mecânica (Distância x Velocidade Médio)
    ROUND(distance_miles * avg_speed_mph, 2) AS mechanical_workload_score,
    fast_break_points,
    touches
FROM raw_tracking

﻿WITH raw_data AS (
    SELECT 
        injury_id,
        player_name,
        injury_date,
        season,
        team,
        notes,
        games_missed_estimate
    FROM "nba_injuries"."bronze"."raw_injuries"
)

SELECT
    injury_id,
    player_name,
    injury_date,
    season,
    team,
    notes,
    
    -- Categorização da Lesão (Sobrecarga Tecidual vs. Trauma de Contato)
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(notes) LIKE '%strain%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%sore%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%tendinitis%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%calf%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%hamstring%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%groin%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%rest%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%load management%'
        THEN 'Overuse / Soft Tissue'
        
        WHEN LOWER(notes) LIKE '%fracture%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%surgery%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%sprain%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%concussion%' 
          OR LOWER(notes) LIKE '%torn%'
        THEN 'Trauma / Contact'
        
        ELSE 'Uncategorized / Other'
    END AS injury_category,
    
    COALESCE(games_missed_estimate, 1) AS games_missed
FROM raw_data

﻿WITH base_game_logs AS (
    SELECT
        game_id,
        player_id,
        player_name,
        game_date,
        season,
        team,
        opponent,
        is_home,
        minutes_played,
        pace,
        fg3a
    FROM "nba_injuries"."bronze"."raw_game_logs"
)

SELECT
    game_id,
    player_id,
    player_name,
    game_date,
    season,
    team,
    opponent,
    is_home,
    minutes_played,
    pace,
    fg3a,
    
    -- Carga Aguda: Minutos jogados nos últimos 7 dias
    SUM(minutes_played) OVER (
        PARTITION BY player_id 
        ORDER BY game_date 
        RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 DAYS' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS acute_load_minutes_7d,
    
    -- Carga Crônica: Média móvel de minutos nos últimos 28 dias
    AVG(minutes_played) OVER (
        PARTITION BY player_id 
        ORDER BY game_date 
        RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '27 DAYS' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) * 4 AS chronic_load_minutes_28d,
    
    -- Flag de Back-to-Back (jogo em dias consecutivos)
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(game_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY game_date) = game_date - INTERVAL '1 DAY'
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END AS is_back_to_back
FROM base_game_logs

﻿WITH season_workload AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        ROUND(AVG(pace), 2) AS avg_league_pace,
        ROUND(AVG(fg3a), 2) AS avg_league_fg3a,
        SUM(is_back_to_back) AS total_back_to_backs
    FROM "nba_injuries"."main_silver"."stg_player_workload"
    GROUP BY season
),

season_injuries AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        COUNT(injury_id) AS total_injuries,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN injury_category = 'Overuse / Soft Tissue' THEN 1 END) AS overuse_injuries,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN injury_category = 'Trauma / Contact' THEN 1 END) AS trauma_injuries
    FROM "nba_injuries"."main_silver"."stg_injuries"
    GROUP BY season
)

SELECT
    w.season,
    w.avg_league_pace,
    w.avg_league_fg3a,
    w.total_back_to_backs,
    COALESCE(i.total_injuries, 0) AS total_injuries,
    COALESCE(i.overuse_injuries, 0) AS overuse_injuries,
    COALESCE(i.trauma_injuries, 0) AS trauma_injuries,
    
    -- Proporção de lesões por sobrecarga tecidual em relação ao total
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(i.overuse_injuries, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COALESCE(i.total_injuries, 0), 0) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS overuse_injury_pct
FROM season_workload w
LEFT JOIN season_injuries i ON w.season = i.season
ORDER BY w.season ASC

﻿WITH workload AS (
    SELECT * FROM "nba_injuries"."main_silver"."stg_player_workload"
),

injuries AS (
    SELECT * FROM "nba_injuries"."main_silver"."stg_injuries"
)

SELECT
    i.injury_id,
    i.player_name,
    i.injury_date,
    i.season,
    i.injury_category,
    i.notes,
    
    w.acute_load_minutes_7d,
    w.chronic_load_minutes_28d,
    
    -- Razão Carga Aguda : Carga Crônica (ACWR)
    -- ACWR > 1.5 indica pico de sobrecarga
    ROUND(
        w.acute_load_minutes_7d / NULLIF(w.chronic_load_minutes_28d / 4.0, 0), 
        2
    ) AS acwr_ratio,
    
    w.is_back_to_back
FROM injuries i
LEFT JOIN workload w 
    ON i.player_name = w.player_name 
   AND i.injury_date = w.game_date
